caption: The drawing depicts three metal hinge straps of various shapes and sizes arranged horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The uppermost object is a large curved strap with a series of rounded rivets along its length, terminating in a decorative, widened flat end with three holes. The middle object is a straight hinge strap with an elongated oval plate on one end that is fitted to a cylindrical hinge barrel, which has a twisted, pointed pin extending downward. This strap is also decorated with evenly spaced rivets and features a rectangular, beveled inset detail near the hinge. The bottom object is another straight strap, similar in design to the middle one but slightly narrower and lacking the oval plate and twisted pin. All three objects are depicted in a dull metallic gray color, with black outlines accentuating their forms and bolts. Shadows and highlights provide a three-dimensional appearance to each strap. The artist's name, "James M. Lawser," is written in small text in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Door Hinges
